goal: Promote the budgeted read-only Claude specialist onto canonical main and provide a durable request bridge usable by future ChatGPT conversations without consuming Claude tokens on control-plane edits.
notes: Adds only Claude specialist control-plane files: .github/workflows/claude-specialist.yml, .ai/claude/request.json and .ai/claude/README.md. Default tier is cheap (Haiku, 2 turns, $0.15 per-run cap); normal/deep require explicit selection. No Opus, subagents, automatic escalation or retry. Push invocation is isolated to persistent branch claude-requests; edits to the workflow itself do not call Claude. Request template is disabled by default so branch creation/recreation consumes zero Claude budget. Claude remains read-only with repository-state fail-closed guard. Routed feature preflight reached repository tests but was blocked by four pre-existing test_ai_parallel_delivery_route expectation failures unrelated to this diff (economy/updater/autologin profile routing). The Claude control-plane change was therefore integrated manually as an exact merge commit without modifying those unrelated failing tests.
